name: Proofpoint TAP: pull delivered threats and permitted clicks
description: Every 5 minutes, reads the TAP SIEM API (/v2/siem/all, JSON) and creates one pending alert per threat message that was delivered and per click on a malicious URL that was permitted (source proofpoint-tap).

secrets.name: PROOFPOINT_PRINCIPAL
secrets.description: TAP service credential principal (sent as the Basic auth user name).

secrets.name: PROOFPOINT_SECRET
secrets.description: TAP service credential secret (Basic auth password).

setup:
## Proofpoint side
1. TAP dashboard > Settings > Connected Applications > **Create New Credential**. Copy the service principal and secret.
2. Store them as `PROOFPOINT_PRINCIPAL` and `PROOFPOINT_SECRET`, allowed host `tap-api-v2.proofpoint.com`.

## How it works
- `GET https://tap-api-v2.proofpoint.com/v2/siem/all?format=json&sinceSeconds=<n>` with HTTP Basic auth. `n` = seconds from the previous run to this run plus 5 minutes of overlap, capped at 3600 (the API reads at most one hour per call). `sinceSeconds` counts back from the API server's clock, so a window always ends at "now".
- `messagesDelivered` (threat messages that reached a mailbox): external id `msg:<GUID>`, severity high for malware/phish/impostor classification, low for spam, medium otherwise.
- `clicksPermitted` (a user clicked a malicious URL and was let through): external id `click:<id>`, severity critical for malware/phish, high otherwise.
- Blocked messages and blocked clicks are not ingested (they were stopped). Add loops over `messagesBlocked` / `clicksBlocked` if you want them.

## Limits
- ponytail: if the run was delayed more than 5 minutes after its fire time, or the previous successful run is more than an hour old, events older than the one-hour read are not fetched.
- At most **250 delivered messages and 250 permitted clicks per run** are ingested (the rest of that window is dropped; the loop's `max_items` caps how many children one run may start).
- Rate limit: 1800 requests per rolling 24 h for `/v2/siem/all` (shared with the other SIEM endpoints except clicks/permitted); every 5 minutes uses 288. 429 fails the run with `Proofpoint TAP pull failed: HTTP 429`.

Docs: [TAP SIEM API](https://help.proofpoint.com/Threat_Insight_Dashboard/API_Documentation/SIEM_API).

config.url: {%- macro ep(s) -%}{%- set mo = s[5:7]|int -%}{%- set y = (s[0:4]|int) - (1 if mo <= 2 else 0) -%}{%- set era = y // 400 -%}{%- set yoe = y - era * 400 -%}{%- set doe = yoe * 365 + yoe // 4 - yoe // 100 + (153 * (mo + (-3 if mo > 2 else 9)) + 2) // 5 + (s[8:10]|int) - 1 -%}{{ ((era * 146097 + doe - 719468) * 86400 + (s[11:13]|int) * 3600 + (s[14:16]|int) * 60 + (s[17:19]|int)) }}{%- endmacro -%}https://tap-api-v2.proofpoint.com/v2/siem/all?format=json&sinceSeconds={{ [ep(trigger.fired_at)|int - ep(trigger.since)|int + 300, 3600] | min }}

config.message: Proofpoint TAP pull failed: HTTP {{ steps.pull.output.status }}

config.title: Delivered {{ ((loop.item.get('threatsInfoMap') or [{}])[0].get('classification') or 'unknown') | lower }} email to {{ (loop.item.recipient if loop.item.get('recipient') is string else (loop.item.get('recipient') or []) | join(', ')) or 'unknown recipient' }}: {{ loop.item.get('subject') or '(no subject)' }}
config.severity: {% set c = ((loop.item.get('threatsInfoMap') or [{}])[0].get('classification') or 'unknown') | lower %}{{ 'high' if c in ['malware', 'phish', 'impostor'] else 'low' if c == 'spam' else 'medium' }}

config.title: Permitted click on {{ (loop.item.get('classification') or 'unknown') | lower }} URL by {{ loop.item.get('recipient') or 'unknown recipient' }}: {{ loop.item.get('url') or '?' }}
